usageNotes: Use this endpoint to read the system journal/syslog of a specific cluster node for troubleshooting services, boot issues, or auditing activity. Requires the Sys.Syslog privilege on /nodes/{node}; API tokens must also have that privilege explicitly granted. Results are paginated via start/limit — omitting both returns the full log, which can be very large on busy nodes.

examples.summary: Fetch the last 100 syslog lines from pve01 for the pve-cluster service since June 1

tips: The 'since' and 'until' patterns accept date-only (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime with optional seconds (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).
Use 'start' + 'limit' together for pagination; 'n' in each returned object is the absolute line number and can anchor the next page's 'start' value.
The 'service' filter maps to systemd unit names (e.g. 'pve-cluster', 'pvedaemon', 'qemu-server'); omit it to see all journal entries.
Output can be extremely large on nodes with many VMs or active services — always set a reasonable 'limit' in production use.
